wasm.reason: The builder's canvas is Compose Multiplatform for Wasm and links its own Material 3, not this catalog's Android artifacts. For the components it has an adapter for the picture is close; where it has none it draws a placeholder. Layout, spacing and typography are near enough to design with and are not what ships.

native.reason: The generated Kotlin compiled against this module's own classpath and rendered under Robolectric — the same lane that produces this catalog's stickers.

frame.$comment: A rectangle, and no geometry block: a phone screen's frame is its device size, which the builder already reads from the device preset, so there is nothing measured for this catalog to publish. The Wear catalog needs one because a round screen's content insets are computed by the library rather than implied by the size.

colorTokens.$comment: The theme roles a colour property or a background modifier may name — the roles a canvas drawing this catalog can resolve. Anything else is a #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB literal. This is Material 3's own vocabulary, which is why this catalog is the one entitled to state it.

propertyCapabilities.name: containerColor
propertyCapabilities.notes: A colour, written as {"type":"color","value":"#RRGGBB"} or as {"type":"colorToken","value":"primary"} naming one of statusSemantics.colorTokens. A string wrapper, or a role the canvas does not draw, is refused at commit.

propertyCapabilities.name: color
propertyCapabilities.notes: A colour, written as {"type":"color","value":"#RRGGBB"} or as {"type":"colorToken","value":"primary"} naming one of statusSemantics.colorTokens. A string wrapper, or a role the canvas does not draw, is refused at commit.

propertyCapabilities.name: variant
propertyCapabilities.notes: Two Material composables that take the same arguments and differ in shape, spelled as one component the way `m3/text-field` spells its two.

propertyCapabilities.name: progress
propertyCapabilities.notes: 0..1, a literal or a `state` read. Absent means the indeterminate indicator — Material's own distinction between a progress you know and one you do not.

propertyCapabilities.name: indeterminate
propertyCapabilities.notes: Draws the running animation rather than a value. Pinned to its first frame on the canvas, because a render that animates is a render that cannot be diffed.
